mapper.insert: INSERT INTO solution_problem_reference (problem_id, exists_flag, del_flag, auth, title, checked_at, requested_at) VALUES (#{reference.problemId}, #{reference.existsFlag}, #{reference.delFlag}, #{reference.auth}, #{reference.title}, #{reference.checkedAt}, #{reference.requestedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE exists_flag = IF(VALUES(requested_at) > requested_at, VALUES(exists_flag), exists_flag), del_flag = IF(VALUES(requested_at) > requested_at, VALUES(del_flag), del_flag), auth = IF(VALUES(requested_at) > requested_at, VALUES(auth), auth), title = IF(VALUES(requested_at) > requested_at, VALUES(title), title), checked_at = IF(VALUES(requested_at) > requested_at, VALUES(checked_at), checked_at), requested_at = GREATEST(requested_at, VALUES(requested_at))
